facts.fact: In Circana's October 2025 survey, 48% of consumers browsed before Thanksgiving, per Circana's guide as cited by Adwave.
facts.quote: In Circana’s October 2025 survey, 48% of consumers browsed before Thanksgiving and 44% planned to shop earlier overall

facts.fact: Adobe forecasts that 57.4% of online holiday spending will happen on mobile, up from 56.4% in 2025.
facts.quote: Adobe also forecasts that 57.4% of online holiday spending will happen on mobile, up from 56.4% in 2025

facts.fact: On Adwave, a campaign's daily budget starts at $30 and covers media, ad creation, and management, with no subscription or contract.
facts.quote: a campaign’s daily budget starts at $30 and covers media, ad creation, and management, with no subscription or contract

facts.fact: On Adwave, TV, Google (Search included), Facebook, and Instagram run from the $30/day minimum.
facts.quote: TV, Google (Search included), Facebook, and Instagram run from the $30/day minimum

facts.fact: On Adwave, TikTok is live and opt-in from about $91/day and requires connecting a TikTok account.
facts.quote: TikTok is live and opt-in from about $91/day

facts.fact: On Adwave, card deposits add the processing fee shown at checkout, while ACH deposits do not.
facts.quote: Card deposits add the processing fee shown at checkout; ACH deposits don’t.

facts.fact: Adwave's example gift shop sets $75 a day for 30 active days from mid-November and would plan for $2,250 in total.
facts.quote: a gift shop that sets $75 a day for 30 active days from mid-November would plan for $2,250 in total
